bilingual_review: Scoped EN/ZH meaning reviewed, parser/header/orphan findings corrected. Literal authored rules, typed source fields, ordered qualifiers/rules/protocols/calculations/quality IDs and atomic row source/protocol/type bindings independently compared.

review.scope: Separately inventoried intact individual spent civilian UO2 PWR rods including integral cladding/ends, compatible CN plant receipt/wet storage/handover before cutting/recovery
review.source_and_method: Root read IAEA entire fuel-element/spent definitions, WCOHS2022 spent-element distinction, ORNL actual unpunctured full-length sister-rod handovers and GAO separately stored rod/fragment context. Entire individual element is real, assemblies/fragments excluded. Foreign cases prove object/principles, never CN inventory. No handling procedures, operating limits, release rate or default factors transferred.
review.native_and_classification: Full generic Nuclear Fuel Rod Product/Mass/kg has at-plant/power-generation context and CN supply binding. No hard fresh/nonirradiated restriction outside serious contrary CPC33710 classification was found. Controller accepts bounded whole physical spent-rod methodology and narrower33720 mapping on independent actual-object evidence, without declaring native classification erroneous. Each actual study must obtain independent nuclear/LCA expert adjudication of contrary metadata, actual CN state/provider fit and absence of hard name/state/composition/route/geography conflicts. This is not unconditional native/provider/scientific approval.
review.event_stock_repair: Unique independently measured first-acceptance Q is locked. General bridge adds real postgate net exits as disjoint parcel states, never another external output. Original Q remains for subsequent services, excluding duplicate return/rework throughput.
limits: Ordinary UUID/provider and empirical-range gaps remain explicit; finite methodology checks are not actual complete plant data or scientific qualification.
Native classification counterevidence and actual process/geography admission remain as stated.

validation_requirement: Exact-source full npm run validate, both mapping-end uniqueness, public derivative/runtime checks and unchanged-baseline serial landing before goal credit.
